summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney with a currency parameter that uses Intl.NumberFormat. invoiceLines now takes a currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Rename breaks remaining formatPrice caller
findings.problem: The change renames formatPrice to formatMoney, but src/cart.ts still imports and calls formatPrice on lines 1 and 8. The money module no longer exports formatPrice.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails on cart.ts. If the build skips type checks, cart total formatting throws at runtime.
findings.fix: Update cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Alternatively, keep formatPrice as a wrapper that calls formatMoney with USD.

findings.title: Changed formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now uses Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators and moves the minus sign before the currency symbol. The repository has no test that covers formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nobody will catch output regressions in invoice and cart strings.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines covering large, negative and non-USD amounts.
